newsitem.title: GERMANY: Porsche talking to VW about off-road car.
newsitem.headline: Porsche talking to VW about off-road car.

text.p: German sports car maker Porsche AG said on Monday it was holding talks with a number of companies including Volkswagen AG about cooperating on the development of a new off-road vehicle.
A Porsche spokesman said the company had not reached a decision on whether to proceed with the project and whether to do so alone or with a partner.
"There are several with whom we are talking," a spokesman said in response to a Reuter enquiry.
News magazine Der Spiegel reported on Monday that Volkswagen AG and Porsche had agreed to cooperate the construction of an off-road vehicle.
Spiegel said VW would launch an off-road vehicle in 2001 and Porsche would offer its own version of the vehicle with a different design and a revamped engine.
